events.title: Event and handler types
events.description: The types of the callbacks and of the middleware: what each one receives and what it may return.

localization.title: Localization types
localization.description: The shape of a locale pack and of the formatters, and the helpers around them.

model.title: Model types
model.description: The data the scheduler places: items, levels, tags, shifts and the layout they produce.

options.title: Options and props types
options.description: The options of the controller and the props of the components, as types.

slots.title: Slot and rendering types
slots.description: The parts, their owner state, and what every slot and render prop receives.

BaseSlotProps.description: What every slot receives: the part’s own props, its owner state and the default component.

props.Default: The default element or component of the part, to wrap or render.
props.ref: MUST be attached: pinning, measuring and focus depend on it.

CARRIED_OVER_TAG.description: Tag key the library adds to carried-over pinned items.

CardContentContext.description: What `renderCardContent` receives: the item, its level and the computed time label.

CardVariant.description: How a card is drawn: normally, as an alert, or muted.

ClassicLevelKey.description: The keys of the classic level scale.

ClassicTagKey.description: The keys of the classic tag set.

CloseReason.description: Why a detail view or the overflow dialog closed.

ColorScheme.description: Which color scheme the component renders in; `'system'` follows the reader's setting.

DateInput.description: Date, epoch milliseconds, or ISO-8601 string (a string without offset is local wall-clock time).

DeepPartial.description: The same shape with every member optional, at every depth.

DefaultItemDetail.description: The detail view an item opens into, as the library renders it.

Density.description: The spacing scale of the rendered parts.

DiamondIcon.description: The pill marker: a 4 × 4 square rotated −45° about (0, 2.828) inside a 6 × 6 box, filled with the current text color.

ElementProps.description: Props a headless host spreads onto one of the library’s elements.

props.ref: A callback ref, so the props spread onto any element.

EmptyContext.description: What `renderEmpty` receives: whether the whole day or one shift is empty.

EmptyState.description: What a view shows when there is nothing to place.

ErrorState.description: What a view shows when loading failed, with the retry action when one is given.

FormatterOptions.description: What the formatters need to know: the locale and the strings around the values.

props.hourLabelFormat: 'compact' removes the space between the hour and a day period ("8AM"); 'locale' keeps Intl output.

HeaderContext.description: What `renderHeader` receives: the signal, the view and the rendered shifts.

ItemDetailContext.description: What `renderItemDetail` receives: the item, how it was opened and a way to close it.

ItemOf.description: Helpers to infer item types from level/tag definitions.

ItemProps.description: Props a custom card spreads onto its activator, so activation and keyboard work.

LandingTarget.description: Where a view lands: on the shift's start, on the date, just above it, or nowhere.

LevelDefinition.description: One rank of the level scale: what it is called, how strong it is, and how its items look.

props.color: Accent color, as any CSS color.
props.key: The key items refer to this level by.
props.label: The label shown on the level pill.
props.onColor: Color of the text and icon on that accent.
props.pinOnPass: Items of this level pin into the pinned strip once they scroll past, and count as carried over.
props.rank: Strength of the level; lower is stronger.
props.variant: How cards of this level are drawn.

LevelPill.description: The pill that shows an item’s level.

ListCard.description: A list card (`li`) with its activator; `renderItem` replaces it entirely.

ListOptions.description: The list view's own options: when navigation appears, where a jump lands, and when the header signal fires.

props.alignOffset: Gap, in pixels, between the sticky top and the shift header a jump landed on.
props.collapseAfterCards: The header signal fires after this many cards of the current shift have scrolled past.
props.collapseMargin: Hysteresis, in pixels, around the point where the header signal flips back.
props.collapseMinItems: The header signal may fire only when the current shift holds more items than this.
props.landing: Where the list lands on first render, on a date change and when the view is entered.
props.navigationThreshold: Navigation appears only when some shift holds at least this many items.
props.previousJumpExtraOffset: Extra offset, in pixels, when the jump goes to an earlier shift, so its last items stay in view.
props.scrollTopThreshold: Scrolling further than this, in pixels, shows the scroll-to-top button.
props.segmentEpsilon: Tolerance, in pixels, for deciding which shift section the scroller sits in.

ListView.description: The list view on its own.

ListViewProps.description: What `<ListView>` accepts: the scheduler props without the view selection.

LoadingState.description: What a view shows while items are being loaded.

Middleware.description: Runs before an interaction: it can inspect it, change it, or cancel it by not calling `next`.

MoreChip.description: The chip that stands for the items a crowded group could not place.

NavLabelContext.description: What `renderNavLabel` receives: the target shift and the carried-over count.

NavPosition.description: Which navigation button an event came from.

NavState.description: What one navigation button shows: where it goes, whether it is disabled, and how many items were carried over.

props.label: Visible label; also the accessible name.

Navigator.description: Moves a view to a shift, an item or a time, with the alignment the options ask for.

props.scrollTo: Scrolls to `target()`; smooth unless `smooth` is false. A new call replaces a pending one.

NavigatorHooks.description: The scrolling the navigator performs, so a host can replace it.

props.onDone: Called `resumeDelay` ms after the final correction (the list resumes pinning).
props.onSettle: Called when the scroll settled, before the final correction frame (force a pin refresh).
props.onStart: Called before a navigation starts (the list pauses pinning).

NavigatorOptions.description: What the navigator needs: the scroller, the shifts and the landing rules.

props.resumeDelay: How long to wait after the final correction before `onDone`, in milliseconds.
props.settleDelay: How long without scroll events counts as settled where `scrollend` is not supported, in milliseconds.

NowIndicator.description: The list's now marker: the clock time in a pill, then a line.

OverflowCellContext.description: What an overflow cell receives: the strings and a way to open the item.

OverflowColumn.description: One column of the overflow table: its header, its cell and how it sorts.

props.maxWidth: Equal to `minWidth`, the column has that fixed width and takes no share of the spare width.
props.sortValue: Omit to make the column unsortable.

OverflowDialog.description: The dialog that lists the items behind a "+more" chip.

OverflowGroup.description: The items a "+more" chip stands for, with the range they cover.

props.anchor: Earliest start of the group, epoch ms.

OverflowSort.description: Which column the overflow table is sorted by, and in which direction.

OverflowTable.description: The table inside the overflow dialog.

OwnerState.description: What a part is rendering for.

Pagination.description: The pager under the overflow table.

PartExtraProps.description: Part-specific extras beyond the element attributes.

PinEngine.description: Watches the scroller and reports which items are pinned by position.

props.refresh: Re-reads every sentinel once (after programmatic scrolls, data changes and mounts). Skipped while paused unless `force` is set.
props.register: Registers a sentinel for `ids` under `key`; returns a ref callback.
props.relayout: Re-creates the observers after the pin line moved (for example, the sticky top resized).

PinEngineOptions.description: What the pin engine needs: the scroller, the rule and the items it may pin.

props.getLine: The pin line in viewport coordinates. List: the sticky top's bottom; timeline: the scroller's top.
props.onChange: Called with the pinned ids whenever they change.

PinSentinelProps.description: Props a custom card spreads onto its pin sentinel, so pinning can observe it.

PinnedChip.description: One chip in the pinned strip.

PinnedStrip.description: The strip of pinned items that stays in view while their shift is on screen.

PinningOptions.description: Where items pin in each view, and in which order the pinned strip lists them.

props.compare: Orders the pinned strip. By default it follows the order the items pinned in.
props.list: The rule the list view pins by.
props.timeline: The rule the timeline view pins by.

PlacedCard.description: One card placed on the timeline: its item, its column and its geometry.

PluralForms.description: The plural forms of one message, selected with `Intl.PluralRules` for the active locale.

PresetName.description: The bundled looks: the library's own, or the classic one it reproduces.

ReducedMotion.description: Whether motion is reduced, and a way to subscribe to that changing.

ReferencePill.description: The pill that shows an item’s reference number.

RenderItemContext.description: What `renderItem` receives, including the props a custom card has to spread.

props.getItemProps: Props for the activator; spreading them is required.
props.getPinSentinelProps: Props for the pin sentinel of a pinnable item (pinning needs it).
props.style: Timeline: the card's structural geometry (absolute position and size).

ResolvedFlags.description: Every feature flag with its value filled in.

ResolvedLevel.description: A level with its rank, colors and label filled in.

Scheduler.description: The scheduler: the list or timeline view, selected by `view`.

SchedulerController.description: The framework-agnostic controller behind the components: state, actions and a subscription.

props.flushPinned: Emits `onPinnedChange` when the strip's ids differ from the last emission for the view.
props.noteViewShown: Records that `view` is shown; true when another view was shown before (a view switch).
props.openItem: Imperative open (`api`): no middleware; disabled or unknown items do not open.
props.reconcileOpenItem: Closes the view of an item that left the data; no middleware, never reopens by itself.
props.resetHeader: Resets the per-view header memory, so the next signal is compared afresh (view enter).
props.setMounted: Marks the owner (un)mounted; an asynchronous `next()` after unmount is ignored.
props.setOptions: Replaces the options. Does not notify: the owner re-renders with the new options anyway.
props.setPinnedByPosition: Ids the view's pin engine pinned by position; `handlers.onPin` may veto each change.

SchedulerEvents.description: State callbacks and domain events. They report what happened; to intervene before it happens, use `handlers`.

props.onActiveShiftChange: The shift the reader is looking at changed, by scrolling or by navigating.
props.onDateChange: The rendered date changed, in the uncontrolled case.
props.onHeaderExpandedChange: The header signal changed. `reason` says what caused it, so a page can ignore the causes it does not care about.
props.onItemClose: The open item was closed, with the reason it closed.
props.onItemOpen: An item was opened. `source` says whether it came from a pointer, the keyboard or the API.
props.onLayout: The timeline recomputed its layout, with the placement of every card.
props.onNavigate: A jump to another shift finished. `position` is `'api'` when the handle was called.
props.onOpenItemIdChange: The open item changed, in the uncontrolled case. `null` means the detail view closed.
props.onOpenOverflowIdChange: The open overflow group changed, in the uncontrolled case.
props.onOverflowPageChange: The overflow dialog's page changed, in the uncontrolled case.
props.onOverflowSortChange: The overflow dialog's sort changed, in the uncontrolled case.
props.onPinnedChange: The set of pinned items changed, with what entered and left it.
props.onViewChange: The view changed, whether by the reader, by the breakpoint or through the API.
props.onVisibleRangeChange: The time range on screen changed. This is the hook for loading a day's items on demand.

SchedulerFlags.description: Feature flags. Turning one off removes the feature and everything it renders; nothing else changes.

props.enableAnimations: Transitions and animations. `reducedMotion` switches them off per reader; this switches them off for everyone.
props.enableCarriedOverCount: The count of items carried over from earlier shifts, shown on the navigation button.
props.enableHeaderSignal: The signal that tells the surrounding page to collapse its header while reading a shift.
props.enableItemDetail: Opening an item shows its detail view.
props.enableNavigation: The buttons that jump to the previous and next shift.
props.enableNowIndicator: The marker for the current time in the list and the line in the timeline.
props.enableOffShiftBands: The shaded bands the timeline draws outside the active shift.
props.enableOverflowDialog: The dialog that lists the items behind a "+more" chip.
props.enablePinning: Items may pin to the edge of the scroller and appear in the pinned strip.
props.enableScrollTopButton: The button that returns the scroller to the top.

SchedulerFormatters.description: The functions that turn times, ranges and counts into text. Replace one to override a single format.

SchedulerHandle.description: The imperative handle: scrolling, opening and closing, and reading the current state.

SchedulerItem.description: One thing on the schedule. Only `id`, `start`, `level` and `title` are required; everything else refines how the card reads.

props.disabled: Not activatable: rendered with aria-disabled, ignored by activation handlers.
props.end: When it ends. An end before the start counts as zero duration.
props.id: Stable, unique, never mutated by the library.
props.level: The `key` of one of the levels in the scale.
props.pinnable: Overrides the level's `pinOnPass` for this item.
props.pinned: Always in the pinned strip while its shift is rendered.
props.tags: Keys of the tags this item carries.
props.timeLabel: Replaces the computed time label entirely.
props.title: The card's first line.

SchedulerLocalization.description: Every string the component can show. A locale pack is one of these.

SchedulerModel.description: The resolved input: options, defaults and state merged into one shape the views read.

props.animate: Smooth scrolling and entrance animations run.
props.currentIndex: -1 when no rendered shift has offset 0.
props.dir: Resolved direction; `explicitDir` is set on the root only when it did not come from the document.
props.openItemMissing: The open id names an item that is no longer in the data.
props.size: Pinned-chip width class from the root width: lg ≥ 900, md 600–899, sm < 600.

SchedulerOptions.description: Everything the controller reads; the React props add render props, slots and styling.

props.compact: The compact layout: `'auto'` switches at `compactBreakpoint`, a boolean forces it.
props.compactBreakpoint: The width, in pixels, below which `compact: 'auto'` turns compact on.
props.compareItems: Orders items inside a shift. The default order is by start, then by level, then by title.
props.date: The day to render, controlled. Pair it with `onDateChange`.
props.defaultDate: The day to start on when `date` is not controlled.
props.defaultDuration: How long an item without an `end` lasts, in milliseconds.
props.defaultHeaderExpanded: The header signal's starting value when it is not controlled.
props.defaultOpenItemId: The item open on first render when `openItemId` is not controlled.
props.defaultOpenOverflowId: The overflow group open on first render when `openOverflowId` is not controlled.
props.defaultOverflowPage: The overflow dialog's page on first open when it is not controlled.
props.defaultOverflowSort: The overflow dialog's sort on first open when it is not controlled.
props.defaultView: The view to start in when `view` is not controlled.
props.density: The spacing scale of the rendered parts.
props.dir: Writing direction. `'auto'` reads it from the surrounding document.
props.error: Renders the error state. Any value is accepted; the message comes from `localization`.
props.formatters: Replaces single formatters, for a house format the locale does not produce.
props.handlers: Middleware that runs before each interaction and can change or cancel it.
props.headerExpanded: The header signal, controlled. Pair it with `onHeaderExpandedChange`.
props.items: The items to place. Each needs an `id` and a `start`; an item without an `end` lasts `defaultDuration`.
props.levels: The level scale: the ranks an item can have, with their colors and labels.
props.listOnlyBreakpoint: Below this width, in pixels, only the list is offered. Leave it out to keep both views at every width.
props.loading: Renders the loading state. With items already present, they stay on screen and the state is shown over them.
props.locale: The BCP 47 locale used to format dates, times and numbers.
props.localization: Every string the component can show. Pass a whole locale pack, or only the entries to replace.
props.now: The moment the "now" indicator points at. Set it to freeze the clock, in a test or a demo.
props.nowTickInterval: How often the clock advances, in milliseconds.
props.openItemId: The open item, controlled by id. `null` closes the detail view.
props.openOverflowId: The open overflow group, controlled by id.
props.overflowColumns: The columns of the overflow dialog's table, in order.
props.overflowPage: The overflow dialog's page, controlled, counted from 1.
props.overflowPageSize: Rows per page in the overflow dialog.
props.pinning: Where items pin, and in which order the pinned strip shows them.
props.reducedMotion: Motion: `'auto'` follows the reader's `prefers-reduced-motion`, a boolean forces it.
props.segments: Ready-made shift segments, for data that is already grouped. Given these, the scheduler does not bucket `items` itself.
props.shifts: The shift pattern of the day: how long a shift is, where it starts, and how many are rendered before and after the current one.
props.tags: The tags an item can carry, with their labels.
props.view: The view to render, controlled. Pair it with `onViewChange`.

SchedulerProps.description: Everything `<Scheduler>` accepts: the controller’s options plus rendering, slots and styling.

props.aria-label: The accessible name of the scheduler region.
props.classNames: A class per part, added to the library's own.
props.colorScheme: Light or dark; `'system'` follows the reader's setting.
props.handlers: Middleware that runs before each interaction and can change or cancel it.
props.headingLevel: The heading level shift headers use, so they fit the page's outline.
props.id: Prefix for the ids of the rendered elements.
props.keepInactiveViewMounted: `<Scheduler>` only: the view that is not showing stays mounted but paused, so switching back is instant and its scroll position survives.
props.onRetry: Shows the retry action in the error state and is called when it is used.
props.overflowColumns: The columns of the overflow dialog's table, in order.
props.preset: Which bundled look to render: the library's own, or the classic one it reproduces.
props.renderCardContent: Replaces the inside of a card while keeping its frame, activation and pinning.
props.renderEmpty: Replaces the empty state. `ctx.scope` says whether the whole day or one shift is empty.
props.renderHeader: Replaces the sticky area above the items, which holds the pinned strip and the navigation.
props.renderItem: Replaces the whole card. `ctx.defaultRender()` gives the built-in one back.
props.renderItemDetail: Replaces the detail view of an open item.
props.renderMoreLabel: Replaces the label of a "+more" chip.
props.renderNavLabel: Replaces the label of a navigation button.
props.renderPinnedChip: Replaces a chip in the pinned strip.
props.renderTimeLabel: Replaces the time label of a card.
props.slotProps: Extra props for a part, either fixed or computed from the state around it.
props.slots: Replaces the component that renders a part, keeping its place and its props.
props.style: Inline style for the root element.
props.tokens: Overrides single design tokens on the root element.
props.unstyled: Renders the structure without the stylesheet's looks, for a design of your own built on `classNames`.

SchedulerSlotProps.description: Extra props for each part, fixed or computed from the state around it.

SchedulerSlots.description: The component for each part, replacing the library’s own.

SchedulerStoreState.description: The controller’s stored state: what the reader changed, before any option is applied.

SchedulerViewModel.description: Everything a view needs to render, derived from the model.

props.pinnedIds: Pinned-strip ids in strip order (position-pinned plus `pinned: true` items).

ScrollFacts.description: What a view measured on its last scroll frame.

props.activeIndex: Index of the active shift in `shifts`.
props.atStart: The view sits at the start of the active shift.
props.nextVisible: List only: the section of the shift with offset +1 is visible below the fold.

ScrollTopButton.description: The button that returns the scroller to the top.

SegmentInput.description: Parity input: pre-bucketed segments (drop-in for the source data shape).

ShiftHeader.description: The header row of one shift in the list view.

ShiftNavButton.description: The button that jumps to the previous or the next shift.

ShiftOptions.description: The shift pattern of a day. Either regular shifts of one length, or an irregular `pattern` of named shifts.

props.after: How many shifts are rendered after the current one.
props.anchor: The wall-clock time one regular shift starts at; the others follow from it.
props.before: How many shifts are rendered before the current one.
props.durationHours: Length of a regular shift, in hours. It has to divide 24.
props.keys: Keys for the regular shifts, assigned in turn from the anchor.
props.pattern: An irregular daily pattern, as start times in order. It replaces `durationHours`, `anchor` and `keys`.

ShiftPatternEntry.description: One shift of an irregular daily pattern: when it starts and what it is called.

props.start: Start wall-clock time. The entry ends where the next entry (cyclically) starts.

ShiftRole.description: Sign of a shift offset relative to the current shift.

ShiftSegment.description: A shift with the items that fall into it, in the order they are rendered.

props.items: Items whose start is in [shift.start, shift.end), in placement order.

ShiftWindow.description: One rendered shift: its offset from the current one, its key and its boundaries.

props.start: Epoch ms at the wall-clock boundaries (DST-safe).

SlotProps.description: Props a slot component receives: the element's attributes plus the base slot props.

SortDirection.description: Sort direction of the overflow table.

SortableColumn.description: The part of an overflow column that sorting needs; `OverflowColumn` (React layer) extends it.

props.sortValue: Omit to make the column unsortable.

TagDefinition.description: One tag an item can carry, with its label and colors.

props.key: The key items refer to this tag by.
props.label: The label shown on the tag pill.

TagPill.description: The pill that shows one of an item’s tags.

TimeGrid.description: The timeline’s hour grid, with the placed cards on it.

TimelineCard.description: A timeline card, absolutely positioned from the layout engine's output.

TimelineLayout.description: The computed timeline: every placed card, every overflow group and the geometry around them.

TimelineLayoutOptions.description: What the layout engine needs besides the items: the hour size, the column caps and the merge window.

TimelineOptions.description: The timeline view's own options: the size of an hour, how many columns overlapping items may use, and when they collapse into a "+more" chip.

props.cardGap: The gap between two cards, in pixels.
props.columnPlacement: Which column an item takes: by its level (`'priority'`) or by the column that frees up first (`'time'`).
props.hourHeight: The height of one hour, in pixels. The density scale adjusts the default.
props.hourLabelFormat: The hour labels down the axis: short (`"8AM"` in en-US) or the locale's own time format.
props.landing: Where the timeline lands on first render, on a date change and when the view is entered.
props.leadMinutes: How much time, in minutes, landing and navigation leave above the target.
props.maxColumns: How many columns overlapping items may spread over.
props.maxColumnsCompact: The crowded cap in the compact layout.
props.maxColumnsCrowded: The cap once more items overlap than `maxColumns`; the rest go to the "+more" chip.
props.minCardHeight: The shortest a card may be drawn, in pixels, however short the item is.
props.nearBottomGutterMinutes: How much time, in minutes, a "near bottom" landing leaves below the target.
props.overflowMergeWindow: How far apart, in milliseconds, two crowded groups may be and still merge into one "+more" chip. `Infinity` merges the whole chain.
props.viewEnterRealignDelay: How long, in milliseconds, the timeline waits after the view is entered before it realigns.

TimelineView.description: The timeline view on its own.

TimelineViewProps.description: What `<TimelineView>` accepts: the scheduler props without the view selection.

Tooltip.description: The tooltip part; `position` comes from `useTooltip` (null while closed).

ViewKind.description: The two views: a scrollable list of cards, or a time axis with placed cards.

bucketItems.description: Puts each item into the window with `start ≤ item.start < end`. Items outside every window are not shown; items with an invalid start are dropped; for duplicate ids the first occurrence wins.

classicTags.description: The classic tag set: the two tags the classic preset renders.

compareByPlacement.description: Placement order: start ascending, then level rank ascending (stronger first), then id.

compensateStickyGrowth.description: Keeps visible content still when `sticky` (inside the scroller) changes height: the scroller moves by the same amount in the same frame, in every engine. The scroller sets `overflow-anchor: none`, so browser scroll anchoring never adds a second shift. While `suspended()` holds (a programmatic scroll that corrects its own target), a change is only noted.

computeTimelineLayout.description: Places items into timeline columns and overflow groups: placement sequence, greedy columns, promotion from overflow, gap fill, geometry, overflow groups (bounded by `overflowMergeWindow`, measured from each group's anchor) and column counts.

createFormatters.description: Builds the default formatters for a locale, which `formatters` can then override one by one.

createNavigator.description: Creates the navigator for one scroller.

createPinEngine.description: Creates the pin engine for one scroller.

createScheduler.description: Creates a controller. This is the whole library without React: feed it options, read the view model, call its actions.

deDE.description: The German (Germany) locale pack, passed to `localization`.

defaultOverflowColumns.description: The columns the overflow table shows when none are given.

enUS.description: The English locale pack, and the default when no `localization` is given.

esES.description: The Spanish (Spain) locale pack, passed to `localization`.

frFR.description: The French (France) locale pack, passed to `localization`.

getShiftWindows.description: The rendered shift windows around `date`, offsets `-before … +after`. The current window is `[latest boundary ≤ date, next boundary)`; offsets walk boundaries across days.

huHU.description: The Hungarian (Hungary) locale pack, passed to `localization`.

interpolate.description: Fills `{{name}}` placeholders. A plural template picks its form for `values.count` with `Intl.PluralRules(locale)`, falling back to `other`. Numbers are formatted with `Intl.NumberFormat`. An unknown placeholder is left as written.

observeCompact.description: `onChange(compact)` with compact = width below `breakpoint`, now and on every change.

observeWidth.description: Calls `onWidth` with the element's content-box width now and whenever it changes. Compact mode and `listOnlyBreakpoint` use the root's width, not the viewport or the user agent.

pageList.description: Pages to show in the pager (0-based): every page when there are at most 7; otherwise the first two, the last two and the current page ±1, with 'ellipsis' in each gap.

prefersReducedMotion.description: The `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` media query; false when media queries are unavailable.

ptPT.description: The Portuguese (Portugal) locale pack, passed to `localization`.

resolveEnd.description: The resolved end of an item: `start + defaultDuration` when `end` is missing or invalid; an end before the start counts as zero duration.

resolveLevels.description: Level definitions keyed by `key`, with `rank` (default: array index), `variant` and `pinOnPass` filled in.

resolveTimeLabel.description: The time label of a card, first match: `timeLabel` as given; "{observed} {observedLabel}" when `observedLabel` is a non-empty string; "{since} {timestamp}" for a valid `since`, or the bare prefix for an invalid one; otherwise "{start} – {end}".

roRO.description: The Romanian (Romania) locale pack, passed to `localization`.

sortOverflowItems.description: Items sorted by the column's value; ties break by `compare`. The whole comparison, ties included, follows the direction. An unsortable or unknown column sorts by `compare` alone.

toMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of a date input; `NaN` when invalid. A string without an offset is local wall-clock time, including date-only strings (which `Date` alone would read as UTC).

useCompact.description: Compact mode from the element's content width; a boolean forces it. False on the server.

useControllableState.description: Controlled when `value` is given, otherwise internal state starting at `defaultValue`.

useNow.description: Epoch ms of `now`, or an internal clock ticking every `interval` ms, paused while the document is hidden.

usePinOnPass.description: Pin-on-pass for custom markup: register sentinels, read the pinned keys.

useShiftModel.description: Shift windows and segments for a date.

useShiftNavigation.description: Programmatic shift navigation for custom markup.

useTimelineLayout.description: The timeline layout of `items`, memoized on its inputs.
